#include <iostream>
#include <queue>
#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>
using namespace std;
const int N = 2000005;
int tot, ne[N], fi[N], zz[N], sl[N], dis[N], S, T, n, m, x[N], y[N], flag[N], w[N], cur[N], k, c, d;
struct Edge {
    int to, next, cap, flow;
};
vector<Edge> e(N);
void add(int x, int y, int z, int v) {
    e[++tot].to = y;
    e[tot].next = fi[x];
    e[tot].cap = z;
    e[tot].flow = 0;
    e[++tot].to = x;
    e[tot].next = fi[y];
    e[tot].cap = -v;
    e[tot].flow = 0;
    fi[x] = tot;
    fi[y] = tot;
}
int bfs() {
    queue<int> Q;
    Q.push(S);
    memset(dis, 0x3f3f3f3f, sizeof dis);
    dis[S] = 0;
    while (!Q.empty()) {
        int now = Q.front(); Q.pop(); flag[now] = 0;
        for (int i = fi[now]; i; i = e[i].next)
            if (e[i].cap && dis[e[i].to] > dis[now] + e[i].flow) {
                dis[e[i].to] = dis[now] + e[i].flow;
                if (!flag[e[i].to]) {
                    flag[e[i].to] = 1;
                    Q.push(e[i].to);
                }
            }
    }
    return dis[T] <= 1e9;
}
int dfs(int x, int y) {
    int s = 0, b;
    flag[x] = 1;
    if (x == T) return y;
    for (int i = e[x].next; i; i = e[i].next)
        if (!flag[e[i].to] && e[i].cap && dis[e[i].to] == dis[x] + e[i].flow && (b = min(y, dfs(e[i].to, min(y, e[i].cap)))) > 0) {
            e[i].flow += b;
            e[i ^ 1].flow -= b;
            s += b; y -= b;
            if (!y) return s;
        }
    return s;
}
int gao() {
    int ans = 0;
    while (bfs()) {
        for (int i = S; i; i = e[i].next)
            cur[i] = e[i].flow;
        ans += dfs(S, 1e9) * dis[T];
        memset(flag, 0, sizeof flag);
    }
    return ans;
}
int main() {
    scanf("%d%d%d%d%d", &n, &m, &k, &c, &d);
    S = 0; T = 1;
    tot = 1;
    for (int i = 1; i <= k; i++) {
        int x;
        scanf("%d", &x);
        add(S, x + 1, 1, 0);
    }
    for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) {
        scanf("%d%d", &x[i], &y[i]);
        add(2 + i * n, T, k, 0);
        for (int j = 1; j <= m; j++)
            for (int l = k; l >= 0; l--) {
                add(x[j] + 1 + i * n, y[j] + 1 + i * n + n, 1, (l * 2 + 1) * d + c);
                add(y[j] + 1 + i * n, n + x[j] + 1 + i * n, 1, (l * 2 + 1) * d + c);
            }
        for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++)
            add(j + 1 + i * n, j + 1 + i * n + n, k, c);
    }
    printf("%d\n", gao());
}
